changeSet.sql:
INSERT INTO role_default_widgets (role_id, widget_id, cell_index) SELECT r.id, w.id, d.cell_index FROM (VALUES ('ADMIN', 'ACTIVE_PROJECTS', 0), ('ADMIN', 'USERS_BY_ROLE', 12), ('ADMIN', 'PROJECTS_BY_STATUS', 13), ('ADMIN', 'BANK_PENDING', 15), ('ADMIN', 'WORK_REPORTS_BY_STATUS', 20),
('MANAGER', 'ACTIVE_PROJECTS', 0), ('MANAGER', 'PAYMENTS_RECEIVED', 12), ('MANAGER', 'WORK_REPORTS_PENDING', 14), ('MANAGER', 'PAYMENTS_BY_PROJECT', 16), ('MANAGER', 'OFFERS_BY_STATUS', 24),
('FINANCIER', 'PAYMENTS_RECEIVED', 0), ('FINANCIER', 'PAYROLL_TOTAL', 1), ('FINANCIER', 'BANK_PENDING', 2), ('FINANCIER', 'BANK_FLOW', 4), ('FINANCIER', 'PAYMENTS_BY_PROJECT', 6), ('FINANCIER', 'RECENT_PURCHASES', 12),
('ESTIMATOR', 'ACTIVE_PROJECTS', 0), ('ESTIMATOR', 'OFFERS_BY_STATUS', 12), ('ESTIMATOR', 'PROJECTS_BY_STATUS', 14),
('SALESMAN', 'ACTIVE_PROJECTS', 0), ('SALESMAN', 'OFFERS_BY_STATUS', 12), ('SALESMAN', 'PROJECTS_BY_STATUS', 14),
('FOREMAN', 'ACTIVE_PROJECTS', 0), ('FOREMAN', 'WORK_REPORTS_PENDING', 12), ('FOREMAN', 'WORK_REPORTS_TREND', 14), ('FOREMAN', 'RECENT_PURCHASES', 24),
('WORKER', 'MY_WORK_REPORTS', 0), ('WORKER', 'ACTIVE_PROJECTS', 8),
('CLIENT', 'ACTIVE_PROJECTS', 0), ('CLIENT', 'PAYMENTS_RECEIVED', 12) ) AS d(role_code, widget_code, cell_index) JOIN roles r ON r.code = d.role_code JOIN dashboard_widgets w ON w.code = d.widget_code ON CONFLICT (role_id, cell_index) DO NOTHING;

changeSet.author: foremen
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO user_dashboard_widgets (user_id, widget_id, cell_index, project_id, created_date, created_by) SELECT u.id, rdw.widget_id, rdw.cell_index, NULL, NOW(), 'system' FROM users u JOIN role_default_widgets rdw ON rdw.role_id = u.role_id WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_dashboard_state s WHERE s.user_id = u.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_dashboard_widgets p WHERE p.user_id = u.id);
INSERT INTO user_dashboard_state (user_id, initialized_at) SELECT u.id, NOW() FROM users u WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_dashboard_state s WHERE s.user_id = u.id);
